posts.title: When Drama Enters, Be the Circuit Breaker
posts.description: Emotional contagion is powerful; we humans cannot not communicate. We all continuously broadcast our moods and thoughts by our facial expressions, body language, tone of voice, posture, vocal cadence, and even by micro-expression. posts.title: So, You Don’t See Yourself as a Leader
posts.description: No problem. Many do not aspire to be a leader nor particularly want the heavy mantle of responsibility that comes with being ‘the’ leader. However, most of us want to: Make better decisions Have greater control over our emotions, reactions, and responses Be more resilient in trying times Accomplish more of what matters to us...

posts.title: Who Gets the Benefit of the Doubt?
posts.description: We humans have a tendency to judge ourselves by our best intentions, our noblest thoughts. However, we tend to judge others by our fears and insecurities, denying them the benefit of the doubt. We are generous interpreters of our own behavior and suspicious prosecutors of everyone else’s.
